dcf_lite.method: 5-yr EPS power value discounted at beta-tilted flat rate, terminal exit P/E + net cash/share

outputs.fair_value_basis: DCF-lite base scenario (5-yr EPS power value + net cash/share)

notes: 3Y cumulative growth forecast converted to per-year CAGR ((1+G)^(1/3)-1)
DCF-lite: growth clamped to [0%, 25%]; discount 10% base + 2pp per beta-unit above 1 (clamped [7%,14%]); exit P/E 0.9x trailing; +net cash/share

bull.thesis: Earnings inflection materializes as forward EPS nearly triples, driving multiple expansion and a re-rating toward the bull-case P/E of 87.5.

base.thesis: Modest growth and stable margins keep the stock near its DCF-lite fair value, but the current price remains well above intrinsic worth.

bear.thesis: Earnings growth disappoints, the high trailing P/E contracts, and the debt burden weighs on valuation, driving the stock down to the bear-case target.

risks.risk: Earnings growth fails to meet forward estimates

Multiple compression from elevated trailing P/E
